effect_description_eng:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. You may play up to 7 play cost's total worth of Digimon cards with the [NSp] trait among them without paying the costs. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] 2 of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card with the [NSp] trait in your hand.
